node.title: L1 intrinsic quotient source-chart census
node.statement: For a fixed received word and intrinsic complete-fiber partition, one source core/petal role assignment determines every source member uniquely: two degree-below-k polynomials agreeing on the (k-1)-point core plus one full petal coincide. Hence there are at most 3^(n/ell) canonical source charts per scale. At ell>=c_0 n/log_2 n this is at most n^(log_2(3)/c_0), and the logarithmically many dyadic intrinsic scales preserve polynomial first-match aggregation. Composed with the bipolar per-chart bound, every fixed polarity box is globally polynomial across intrinsic quotient charts. Partial cores, non-intrinsic quotient maps, and arbitrary petals remain open.
